2608.16411.title: Towards Risk-free AI Agent Deployment
2608.16411.paper_summary: LLM-based agents are rapidly moving from research prototypes into the core business processes of organizations, but these agents pose deployment risks to security, compliance, and functionality. In this article, we argue that risk-free deployment must be grounded in the agent's trajectory: the recorded sequence of reasoning steps, tool invocations, and environmental observations. Trajectories are available for any agent, and many failures are visible only in the trajectory. To make agents deployable and sustainable, we advocate agent testing and debugging as a systematic research direction for detecting and mitigating these risks. This article begins with the challenges of testing agents, including the oracle problem, non-determinism, trajectory validation, and the absence of adequacy metrics. We then turn to debugging agents, from automated failure attribution to repair and self-evolution. We distill these directions into a practical deployment-readiness checklist covering the full deployment lifecycle. Finally, we identify open problems, i.e., formal adequacy metrics, root-cause attribution over long-horizon trajectories, and the reliability of self-evolving agents, that the community must address to enable trustworthy agent deployment.
2608.16411.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於的代理正在迅速從研究原型轉向組織的核心業務流程，但這些代理在部署時對安全性、合規性和功能性構成風險。在本文中，我們主張無風險的部署必須基於代理的軌跡：記錄的推理步驟、工具調用和環境觀察的序列。任何代理都有其軌跡，許多故障僅在軌跡中可見。為了使代理可部署且可持續，我們倡導將代理測試和調試作為系統化的研究方向，以檢測和減輕這些風險。本文首先探討測試代理的挑戰，包括預言者問題、非確定性、軌跡驗證和缺乏充分性指標。然後，我們轉向代理的調試，從自動故障歸因到修復和自我演化。我們將這些方向提煉成一個實用的部署準備檢查表，涵蓋整個部署生命周期。最後，我們確定了社群必須解決的開放問題，即正式的充分性指標、長期軌跡的根本原因歸因以及自我演化代理的可靠性，以促進可信的代理部署。
